messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High error rate from cloud-kms in us-west2 — request signing failing and multiple service startups erroring. Auto-ticket created: INC-208123. Paging oncall.

maya: seeing spike in startup failures for the auth-proxy and signer workers. lots of 504/timeout from KMS. customer-facing requests are falling back but some jobs fail to start.

jonas: logs: `ERROR signing request: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded` across multiple hosts.

lucy: confirmed — telemetry shows KMS API latency 95th ~ 3.2s, 99th ~ 8s for us-west2. retries are exhausted.

prateek: impact: onboarding and scheduled batch jobs failing to acquire keys on boot -> ~5% of requests returning 500s; interactive latencies increased but most still succeed due to cache.

oncall: acknowledged, joining. Starting triage.

maya: mitigation ideas: 1) widen KMS client timeouts + aggressive retries, 2) enable local fallback signing for a small set of non-PII services, 3) restart failing pods with env SKIP_KMS_FETCH=true to let them proceed using cached key material. which is safest?

jonas: prefer 1 + 3. Fallback signing requires policy ok and audit note. we need product/ security approval before broadly enabling. do we have per-service fallback toggles?

lucy: auth-proxy has SKIP_KMS_FETCH and will use cached key from instance if present. signer workers do not — they strictly call KMS at startup. we can patch a short-circuit for signer in the deployment to use cached key if present.

prateek: customer-impact classification: P2 for now (partial degradation) but can escalate if signers keep failing and more services can't start. notify support and CS for customers on Dedicated instances in us-west2.

maya: immediate actions: - add 2s -> 8s timeout and exponential backoff for KMS clients in runtime config - roll patch to signer to accept cached key env var - open cloud provider ticket and request SRE liaison

deploy-bot: Started rollout: kms-client-timeout-bump on infra-config (2 -> 8s). Canary: 5 pods in us-west2.

jonas: monitoring: w/ timeout bump we should reduce grpc context cancellations and let retries absorb transient slowness. watch for backlog.

lucy: I pushed signer patch to staging: `if ENV["USE_CACHED_KMS_KEY"] == "1" && cached_key_present -> use cached`. ready for canary.

maya: coordinating with support: @support-team, please prepare customers list for us-west2 dedicated tenants. include any SLA-sensitive accounts.

prateek: reached out to cloud provider support — case #CP-208123: elevated latency in KMS control plane us-west2. they responded acknowledging a regional control-plane degradation; engineering investigating. ETA unknown.

oncall: canary results (10m): signer pods with cached-key flag booted successfully (0/10 failures). non-canary signers still failing. Errors dropped ~70% in the canary group.

maya: moving to broader rollout: patch + env toggle to 30% of signer fleet in us-west2. will schedule gradual increase. audit log disabled? we must record this as emergency exception.

jonas: opened internal compliance note in INC-208123: emergency fallback activated — local cached signing used for limited services. retention: actions captured.

lucy: live metrics: KMS client error-rate down 60% after timeout bump + partial cached signers. startup failure rate reduced from 12% -> 3% in canary region.

prateek: provider update: they are throttling requests due to control-plane maintenance; recommended reduce request rate and enable client-side jitter/backoff.

maya: changed autoscaler to slow restart churn (grace period increased) to avoid surge of new KMS calls on recovery.

oncall: handoff to night oncall in 30m. summary for handoff: provider KMS degraded in us-west2 causing signer startup failures and occasional runtime signing timeouts. mitigations: increased KMS timeouts, enabled cached-key fallback for signer canary -> success, rolling to 30% with audit note; contacting provider. watchlist: signer startup failure rate, KMS error-rate, support escalations. pager duty severity remains P2.

jonas: add runbook pointers: /runbooks/kms-degradation and /runbooks/signing-fallback (links sent in DM).

maya: support notified customers, status page updated: "Partial degradation affecting service startups in us-west2; workarounds applied; provider investigation ongoing."

lucy: quick log sample: ```time="20:12:04" level=error msg="failed to sign request" err="rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded" host=signer-23 region=us-west2```

prateek: provider posted an advisory: "KMS control-plane experiencing increased latencies due to internal maintenance; clients may see elevated latencies. We will provide updates."

oncall: acknowledged handoff. leaving the channel. :thumbsup:

maya: plan for follow-up in incident doc: - full fleet rollout plan if provider doesn't recover - rollback steps for cached-key path - security review / postmortem with customer impact table - timeline and communication draft for sales/CS.

jonas: tagging for postmortem: eng-runtime, eng-sre, security, support. assign leads: maya (incident lead), prateek (provider liaison), jonas (mitigation engineering).

lucy: last check before handoff: signer startup failure rate in us-west2 at 2.8%, KMS RPC error-rate 0.9% absolute (was 3.4% before). continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: INC-208123 updated: status -> mitigated (partial), severity -> P2, playbook -> kms-degradation.

maya: closing handoff note. night oncall — escalate immediately if failure rate or customer impact increases.

oncall: confirmed handoff received at 2081234785.
